placement.claim: A separately identified qualification profile at the existing retained-task, lifecycle and packaged-host boundaries. Existing owners retain operation meaning, admission, persistence, execution and settlement; no parallel lifecycle owner or general observation platform. The exact native-harness enforcement route remains to be established.

reopening_conditions: The selected existing harness cannot exclude or gate undeclared model-invocable tools before their effects; do not infer enforcement from post-hoc history.
A required operation, confidentiality, cancellation, recovery or settlement fact still depends on unavailable world evidence under the proposed controlled starting conditions.
Original claim mapping reveals that a proposed exclusion weakens a requirement the acceptance owner has not explicitly changed.
Current store, compiler/verifier or native-profile composition cannot supply the named evidence without a materially different implementation boundary.
Complete implementation, review and qualification cannot be bounded economically; return a decision instead of adding prerequisites indefinitely.

authority.decision_owner: user as S10 acceptance owner, or an explicitly delegated acceptance owner
